items.claim: Gigi Diamond Canudo lacks defensive skills and physicality.
items.quote: there's just a lot going on with her. Like there's no defense, there's no physicality and that's where I get concerned.

items.claim: Gigi Diamond Canudo has some offensive success throwing hard on the feet.
items.quote: she tries to throw hard on the feet now and she will land a little bit. You know, there is some success offensively

items.claim: Carol Annabel Foro will out-physical Gigi Diamond Canudo.
items.quote: she's going to be out physicalled by Carol Photo.

items.claim: Carol Annabel Foro has a cleaner and more effective boxing style with powerful hooks compared to her opponent.
items.quote: Foro is going to be way cleaner with her boxing combinations. Even though the way she kind of swings them from the hips, but it's like an effective boxing style, the way that she throws her hooks and like it's powerful.

items.claim: Carol Annabel Foro has defensive concerns regarding her bottom-side grappling.
items.quote: I just I get concerned about some of her bottom side grappling and what could happen if she ends up there in this fight.
